domain: A genuine structural sibling of the already-adopted template (same Func_080056cc/Func_08005c68/Func_08020244/Func_0801776c/Func_08028df4 call sequence and the same 'busy poll -> UiWork_FinalizePendingCore-style cleanup' shape), but with real differences: the id passed to Func_08020244 comes from a runtime global (Data_02002004) rather than the literal 0 the template uses, the third Func_08028df4 argument is 0 rather than 3, there is an extra conditional block (a byte-table lookup gating a whole extra confirm-and-wait sequence before the template's own confirm-and-wait) driven by a table indexed by the found id, and the final pair of Func_08005920 calls plus a Func_080f9010 status write have no counterpart in the template at all.
behavior: result=0; if Func_080056cc() is nonzero, report message Value_0000000a and set result=-9
otherwise: Func_08005c68(); id = Func_08020244(Data_02002004, 0); if id==-1, result=id

otherwise: if a byte at a table indexed by id (stride 64, base offset 0x105c off a runtime workspace) is nonzero, run a confirm-message/wait-for-UiWork/Func_08028df4(1,0,0,1) sequence and, if that call succeeds, skip straight to cleanup

in the remaining path: write a status byte (85) tagged with id via Func_080f9010, run the confirm-message/wait sequence again, call Func_0801f818/Func_0808a5b0, call Func_08005920 twice (once with id, once with id+3, against two different fixed workspace regions) and OR the results; report either an error message (Value_0000000b, result=-3) or a success message (Value_00000017) depending on that combined flag
always finish with Func_08005cf8() and return result

bounded_search.reason: One complete candidate was written directly against the retained assembly and the template's established shape; it lands within 8 bytes of reference (280 vs 288) with the opening sequence (through the Func_080056cc busy check) already instruction-for-instruction identical, but the runtime-global read at Data_02002004 (read once as a full word for a later table-base pointer and again as a truncated s16 for the Func_08020244 call -- the same address read at two different widths) and the workspace table-offset arithmetic (0x105c, and the two Func_08005920 destination regions) are lower-confidence reconstructions of what the raw pool constants actually mean.

remaining: The overall call sequence and branch structure are corroborated by the template and are high-confidence; the main open question is the exact type/read pattern for the Data_02002004 global (this draft models it as a pointer read as a full word for later indexing plus a separate truncated-s16 read for the id, which is speculative) and the precise addresses/strides behind the 0x105c table lookup and the two Func_08005920 destination offsets (modeled here as +0x1000 and +0x2000 off Data_02000000, not verified against any other owner). A verification pass cross-checking those pool constants against other owners that touch the same 0x0200xxxx workspace would likely close most of the remaining 70-instruction gap.
